programme.title: BBC News

programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about - they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: Hosted by BBC technology journalist Thomas Germain and social media expert Professor Jessica Maddox, The Interface dives into the stories, trends, apps, gadgets, algorithms and internet obsessions shaping how we live, work, think and connect. From AI and influencers to memes, data leaks, cybersecurity and the weirdest corners of the web, The Interface explores what happens when technology collides with real life. Cutting through the hype, the hosts unpack the platforms, products and online phenomena that increasingly shape our choices, our culture and our sense of self - whether we like it or not! Sharp, insightful and often very funny, The Interface examines our relationship with technology in all its messy, brilliant, absurd and world-changing glory. Along the way, it tackles one of the biggest questions of our age: what kind of future are the likes of Elon Musk, Chat GPT and all the other Silicon Valley giants building, and does anyone really want to live there?

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The Travel Show is a BBC travel programme. The new programme launched in February 2014,[1] and is the immediate successor of long standing travel programme, Fast Track. Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

programme.title: Focus on Africa
programme.desc: Focus on Africa is a BBC news program broadcast globally and on local partner channels of the BBC in African countries. The program used to be presented by Komla Dumor each weekday from its inception until his death in 2014; now it is hosted by Sophie Ikenye, a news presenter from Kenya. The program includes news, sport and business from across Africa and the rest of the globe. Get the top African stories and keep up with the latest international events.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Tim Whewell reports from eastern Libya, where a vast reconstruction programme led by the Haftar family is transforming cities and reshaping the country's political future. As new roads, housing projects and landmarks emerge, we examine whether stability and development are outweighing concerns about accountability and democratic change. Plus: we follow Zaher, a young Sudanese boy whose life was changed by war when a drone strike left him severely injured. A year on, we meet him in Cairo as he learns to walk with prosthetic limbs and begins rebuilding a childhood interrupted by conflict.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Nella the Princess Knight is a British-American animated children's television series that follows adventurous life of fun-loving and fearless princess Nella who turns into a knight when necessary in order to protect her kingdom. Her main treasure is not her crown but her beloved friends- unicorn Trinket, steed Clod and Sir Garrett. Nella sees that no harm comes to her friends and all other citizens of her kingdom. Together with her friends they have fun, solve mysteries and overcome hardships without which life is impossible even in the happiest kingdom.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: Forget Me Mutt:Dudley is the only T.U.F.F. agent who overhears Snaptrap's latest diabolical plan. Unfortunately, our four-legged hero develops a form of amnesia which has him believing he's the Chief, Kitty, Keswick, and Snaptrap. Kitty is left to thwart D.O.O.M.'s latest evil plan.Mind Trap:Dudley, Kitty, and Keswick try on a mind-reading helmet and are insulted by Chief's secret opinion of them. Snaptrap steals the mind-reading helmet, goes on a wild crime spree and kidnaps Chief.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Whilst hunting in the snowy wilderness, Billy takes refuge in a seemingly abandoned log cabin when he suffers a shotgun wound to the leg. Inside, kind and kooky lone inhabitant, old lady Agnes, is keen to nurse Billy back to health. But Billy soon learns this is no ordinary cabin, for he and Agnes are stalked by bloodthirsty skinless creatures that lurk in the surrounding forest, leaving them trapped together inside the cabin in a fight to stay alive.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

Rock, the moral compass of the group, is always struggling at his dream of becoming a model; Paper is an inventor and the brains of the group (if by "brains" you mean "making stuff that's always blowing up"); and Scissors is the wannabe cool guy whose ego brings an endless fountain of chaos to these three friends. No matter how much they compete and mess with each other, at the end of the day, they will always bond over their shared love of one thing: wacky nonsense.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: On their way back from Lake World, the Wylde Paks get stuck in a massive traffic jam. The situation gets so dire that all the drivers have no choice but to set up camp - a camp that quickly turns into its own, self-governing, rudimentary society. Struggling with a vacuum of power, Jack is chosen as their reluctant leader, but he's determined to usher them into peace. Meanwhile, Lily catches feelings for a boy in a nearby car, but because the boy's dad and Will have serious road rage beef, their romance is forbidden. // Desperate to leave their mark on Canyon Valley, Jack and Lily set out to capture the great beast of Canyon Valley Lake - a giant fish that has menaced the town for years. After being swallowed whole multiple times, Lily and Jack realize they must take a different approach, but then they hear horror stories from other townsfolk about their own run-ins with the giant fish proving that bagging the beast is an impossible task. Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: On Leif Erikson Day, Patrick and SpongeBob time closet back to Viking times to witness GrandPat's alleged Viking adventures. When they arrive, the two learn that GrandPat is merely a meatball boy and take it upon themselves to train him to be a real Viking. // When the Star family goes to play in the \"mountains\", Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies at the Chum Bucket. Plankton capitalizes on this opportunity for evil, and tries to steal the secret formula, then hold his audience hostage. It's on Squidina to save the audience, her family and the Patrick Show itself.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: A Kipper for Skipper: It's off to the races when Skipper agrees to give a day off from hard training to the first penguin who can bring him a kipper. Private, Rico, and Kowalski battle their way to a fish packing plant where they discover Officer X has become Fishmonger X. The deranged X sniffs out the fighting penguins, capturing them and hauling them off to the pokey. Can they rediscover the teamwork they had forsaken in order to escape? High Moltage: The penguins are determined to make opening day of their favorite action star's blockbuster movie! Private, however, has an itchy problem - he's turned hideous because he's molting! The penguins need his hypercute powers to knock Alice out and disengage her new zoo security system. The despondent bird does all he can to reconstruct his cuteness, but sadly his hypercute powers distort to cause a hyperalarming, hypervomitous mess!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

The situation gets so dire that all the drivers have no choice but to set up camp - a camp that quickly turns into its own, self-governing, rudimentary society. Struggling with a vacuum of power, Jack is chosen as their reluctant leader, but he's determined to usher them into peace. Meanwhile, Lily catches feelings for a boy in a nearby car, but because the boy's dad and Will have serious road rage beef, their romance is forbidden. // Desperate to leave their mark on Canyon Valley, Jack and Lily set out to capture the great beast of Canyon Valley Lake - a giant fish that has menaced the town for years. After being swallowed whole multiple times, Lily and Jack realize they must take a different approach, but then they hear horror stories from other townsfolk about their own run-ins with the giant fish proving that bagging the beast is an impossible task. Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Feline Fervor: King Julien is literally bounced out of his kingdom and onto the New York streets. A kindly old lady thinks he's a cat and swoops him up. He's encroaching on another's turf, though - the apartment's already home to a feline-impersonator, a female ferret named Zoe. Julien is taken with Zoe, and puts on his best seduction moves. Will the street-smart ferret succumb to his kingly charms? Smart money says… you never know! Action Reaction: Skipper is forced to live his worst nightmare when he's doused with Inflatium and stress causes him to blow up like a balloon. Guess what this means… no more going on missions! Sitting behind a desk doing paperwork instead! Hans takes advantage of the situation and targets a massive weapons lab, and without Skipper the penguins are easily captured. How can Skipper combat the evil puffin if he's in a puffy state?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Feline Fervor: King Julien is literally bounced out of his kingdom and onto the New York streets. A kindly old lady thinks he's a cat and swoops him up. He's encroaching on another's turf, though - the apartment's already home to a feline-impersonator, a female ferret named Zoe. Julien is taken with Zoe, and puts on his best seduction moves. Will the street-smart ferret succumb to his kingly charms? Smart money says… you never know! Action Reaction: Skipper is forced to live his worst nightmare when he's doused with Inflatium and stress causes him to blow up like a balloon. Guess what this means… no more going on missions! Sitting behind a desk doing paperwork instead! Hans takes advantage of the situation and targets a massive weapons lab, and without Skipper the penguins are easily captured. How can Skipper combat the evil puffin if he's in a puffy state?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: Harcourt - 1 Exhibition, 3 Shootings
programme.desc: Since 1934, Studio Harcourt has turned light into an art form — and a signature. Generations of artists, actors and celebrated personalities have passed through its Parisian studios, drawn to the unique Harcourt portrait ritual: sculpted light, an atmosphere suspended in time, and an extraordinary ability to transform a face into an icon. For "Vertige," the Studio opens its doors to three photographers: Cécile Plaisance, Stéphanie Renoma and Philippe Guédon. Three distinct visual languages, three sensibilities, three ways of portraying the female body. Yet they share a common vision: to portray women who no longer ask permission to exist. Behind the scenes of the exhibition, we first meet Cécile Plaisance, whose work plays with layering, illusion and the shifting effects of lenticular photography. Her images seem to transform before our eyes, as though several realities could inhabit a single body. A visual exploration that challenges traditional representations of femininity and the roles society has sought to impose upon women. Then Stéphanie Renoma takes us into her intensely cinematic universe. Body, intimacy, glamour, androgyny: in her work, sensuality is never simply about being looked at. It becomes a form of power. Her women seem to have stepped straight out of a film noir — mysterious, vulnerable, provocative and utterly untamed. With Philippe Guédon, the body becomes a space of freedom. A photographer, filmmaker and creative director, he has long explored aesthetics, desire and the representation of the liberated body. Shaped in part by his work with Normal Magazine, his visual language embraces a sensual, provocative and unapologetically visual approach to photography. Three photographers, three visions in dialogue. Because behind the title "Vertige" lies a simple yet powerful idea: that precise moment when something shifts. When desire becomes a decision. When hesitation disappears. When a woman stops wondering how she should be looked at — and decides for herself how she wants to be seen.

After making Wade his video the icarly team decides to get back at Wade when they find that his mother wasn't even sick. They give Wade the video and have David Archuleta on the show, during which they release a recorded video of Wade's cruel behavior; like spiting on the floor, yelling at Gibby, calling everyone "hob-knockers" and finally yelling "I hate America", they then release the location of his hotel and door number, so any one who wants to "give Wade a …..piece of their mind" can. Meanwhile Spencer fails to lie to the cashier at the movie rental place, but his honesty is enough to convince her to erase the debt from the computer.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Sam wants lessons from Carly on how to be girlier and be a better person to attract her classmate, Pete. At the end of the episode, Pete arrives at the Groovy Smoothie, ready to go on a date with Sam. The bully at school, Jocelyn also arrives to bother the iCarly team. So Sam beats her up, not knowing that Pete was watching. Meanwhile, Spencer starts sporting his tuxedo daily because he thinks it's the reason why a woman he met likes him. He is convinced later that she doesn't just like him in his tux because she kisses him (even though the tux is still on, so she might just like him with the tux on).

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Chaos is coming to Tori Vega's life. The 16 year old is starting at a new high school; but not just any school. This is Hollywood Arts, a performing arts school where crazy talented students learn how to become real artists.. Until now, Tori didn't think she had much talent of her own, and was content to live in the shadow of her older sister, Trina. Now, that's all about to change... if Tori can see herself in a new light, even a spotlight! But Hollywood Arts is still a high school, and Tori is still the new kid. She'll have to find new friends, do homework, and just try to fit in. Will Tori grab a starring role in her new life?

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?"

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donnie's trapped in a mad scientist's lab by the Monster Mutanimals Tokka, Rahzar, Scale Tail, Antrax and Wyrm who are after Wingnut's blood. Meanwhile, Leo, Mikey and Raph try to get pizza but the shop owner is furious: they've made a mess of the place too many times! But the Turtles have never been there before! They're confused until another Tokka wrecks the place in a huge fight before exploding into ooze...and then another Tokka arrives! In the lab, Donnie plans his escape but stumbles upon a video of Rahzar who explains the Monster Mutanimals are doomed unless they find the blood of a stable mutant... and they need Donatello's help! A real-life Rahzar lunges at Donnie, who fights him off until a whole pack of Monster Mutants shows up. The other three Turtles track their Tokka to the lab but are quickly captured. Donnie can only watch as his brothers are shoved into cages... and confronted by the creator of the Monster Mutanimals, the mad scientist Jordan Perry!

programme.title: That Girl Lay Lay

Trying to adapt to this new world, Lay Lay learns it's not easy to blend in when you're the epitome of fierce. But with Sadie by her side, the two best friends can accomplish anything!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: New adventures for The Thundermans unfold after Phoebe and Max are sent undercover to handle a new threat in the seaside town of Secret Shores, and bring Chloe along to develop her superhero talent. While they investigate suspicious activity coming from the local school, Chloe forms a bond with two classmates, who don't realize their new friend has secret powers. As the danger increases, the Thunderman trio must stay in town indefinitely, leaving the squabbling twins in charge of raising their younger sister.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly's old friend Missy Robinson returns to Seattle and tries to become Carly's only best friend and replace Sam because she was Carly's best friend first. Sam was given expired chocolate by Missy, and she destroyed Sam's cell phone, and in addition, Missy texted Sam the wrong address to a helicopter base, that she intended to go on with Missy, and Carly. Missy's actions are claimed "accidental", however Sam realizes what Missy is trying to do, but no one believes her as they think Sam is being "her usual paranoid self", because she was being paranoid when she thought Lewbert was an undercover cop, because she thought his giant wart was a spy cam and thought Gibby was a mermaid because he doesn't like wearing shirts. Missy confesses to Sam, but since no one will believe her, she is forced to ask Freddie for help, so when Freddie wins a six month cruise, he gives it to Missy so she will go away. Shortly after Missy is awarded with the cruise, Carly discovers Missy's plans to destroy her and Sam's friendship. Meanwhile, while packing for a camping trip, Spencer is locked in the basement by a psychotic boy, Chuck, seeking revenge from Spencer for telling on him and getting him grounded in the episode "iHurt Lewbert". Chuck is eventually caught at the end of the episode and is grounded by his father.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer gets a new credit card after canceling his old one, causing Carly, Sam, and Freddie to lose control of the iCarly.com domain. Luckily, Mandy (who appeared in "iAm Your Biggest Fan") returns to buy their website back for them, but she gets tricked into giving it to Nevel. Spencer disguises as an old woman to trick Nevel into signing the URL transfer document during a book signing, but is chased out by security after Nevel recognized him. Later, Nevel demands a kiss from Carly in return to claim the transfer document. Carly confronts Nevel, and Nevel signs the document. However Carly escapes with the signed document without having to kiss Nevel and succeeds in reclaiming their website.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Sitcom about a girl named Tori Vega, who navigates life at an elite Hollywood performing arts high school. Sinjin enlists the gang's help with his game show, Queries for Couples. He pairs Tori with Robbie, Andre with Cat, and Beck with Jade. During the show Beck and Jade realise that they are unhappy in their relationship, so Tori, Andre, Robbie, and Cat decide to hang out without them. This forces Jade and Beck to wonder whether or not they should remain as a couple. Tori puts up with her heavily battered phone while waiting for the release of a new model. Robbie thinks he and Tori are a couple after being paired together on the game show.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. Spencer gets frustrated with her and Carly gets lessons from an art class. Spencer barges in, telling the teacher she is not teaching "art" right. At the end of Spencer and Carly's plot, Carly's art teacher and Spencer kissed. For Freddie and Sam's plot, Freddie offered Sam $200 for her half of their locker. Sam approved the offer. A few moments later, Sam's mom comes to pick Sam up, but inadvertently destroys Locker 239, with her car hitting the wall where the locker was standing. Sam jumps in the car with Freddie's money, leaving him face to face with Mr. Howard.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: iCarly is about teenager Carly who produces her own web show named iCarly along with her three friends Freddie, Sam and Gibby. The show is broadcasted from a studio Carly constructed in the flat where she lives with her 29 years old brother and guardian Spencer. While producing a webshow Carly is not looking for fame or fortune. Ideally she wants to be a role model for children and teenagers. iCarly ultimately features everything from comedy sketches and talent contests to interviews, recipes, and problem-solving.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Sitcom about a girl named Tori Vega, who navigates life at an elite Hollywood performing arts high school. Tori notices that Andre's new girlfriend Hope is bossy and worries that he is changing to please her. He explains that he is only dating her because her dad is a famous record producer. Andre wants to break up with her because he knows it is wrong, but does not want to miss the chance to perform at her birthday in front of her dad. After her breakup with Beck, Jade decides to help Cat look after her mother's boss's dog. Things go awry when Jade accidentally damages the boss's guitar - autographed by Elvis Presley - so they turn to Robbie and Beck for help.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Rubble ja meeskond tahab müüja Gabrielile parimat rannapäeva korraldada... ka sõitu uuel vaaterattal. Kui farmer Zoe loomad vajavad lõõgastumist, siis kutsad ehitavad täiusliku koha, kus harjutada treener Karimaga joogat.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Hr Krokodill
programme.desc: Daisy ja hr Krokodill otsivad õnnetoovas eset, et rattaloteriid võita. Kui hr Krokodill ei jää esimesel pidžaamapeol magama, siis Daisy aitab põhjust leida.

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbazoo on valmis aitama, aga Barbabright ja Barbabelle kasutavad ta headust ära ja ajavad ta hulluks. Barbazoo mõistab, et suudab Barbapapat järele teha. Ta kasutab võimalust, et jagada kodutöid vendade ja õdede vahel. Kas nad saavad teada?

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbalapsed arvavad, et toiduga saavad nad värvi ja kuju muuta. Nad otsustavad üksteisele täiusliku toidu leida. Barbabeaul pole inspiratsiooni ega saa enam kunstiga tegeleda. Kogu pere soovitab talle uusi asju, mida maalida.

programme.title: Tim Rex kosmoses
programme.desc: Tim tõestab, et Kai isa on kapten Dinotäht. Tim proovib lõõgastuda, aga Tial on teised plaanid. Tim saab linna parimad küpsised, aga varsti saab teada, et teised vajavad neid temast rohkem.

programme.title: Tim Rex kosmoses
programme.desc: Tim ja Kai proovivad leida esemeid, mis on randa maetud. Tim viskab vanu asju minema, aga varsti avastab, et kõik pole mõeldud prügikasti. Tim, Tia ja Tommy proovivad vanemaid veenda, et nad võtaks kodulooma.

programme.title: Tim Rex kosmoses
programme.desc: Rexi pere läheb galaktikareisile, et jõuda Raketimaailma. Tim ja Kai võistlevad, et saada Terri Kosmosemaa piletit. Tim, Tia ja Tommy otsustavad talendisõu korraldada, aga nad ei suuda otsustada, kes esineb esimesena.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Uus animasari toob ekraanile hulga hakkajaid koerakutsikaid ja palju põnevaid ehitusmasinaid! Rubble ja tema pere - tädi, vanaisa, nõod ja teised - aitavad ehitada Ehitajatepesa linnast tõeliselt toreda elupaiga. Esimeses osas ootab neid ees suur ülesanne: sillaehitus! Kui kavala Kiirusemeistri plaanid hakkavad seda takistama, peavad kutsikad tegutsema ühiselt ja leidma nutika viisi, kuidas päästa päev ja ehitada turvaline sild.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Mis oleks toredam kui üks kutsu ehitusmasinas? Palju kutsusid ehitusmasinates. Rubble ja tema pere - tädi, vanaisa, nõod ja teised - teevad kõvasti tööd, et nende kodulinn, Ehitajatepesa, oleks üks igati v-auhh-va koht, kus elada.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Hirvemeeskond
programme.desc: Meie kapjadega kangelased on tagasi ja seekord läheb Hirvemeeskond siit maailmast minema! Valmistu kangelaslikeks planeedijõu päästmisteks suurema jõu, lahedate uue tegelaste, imeliste vidinate ja esimest korda, erakordsete kosmose seiklustega!

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbabright katab maja maagilise tootega, et veelekkeid ei tekiks. Järgmisel päeval tõmbub maja kokku nagu õhupall. Lind ehitab pesa Barbazoo kõhule. Barbazoo tahab muutuda suureks puuks, et loomadele kodu pakkuda. See muutub keeruliseks.

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbalib tahab osaleda kirjutusvõistlusel, aga ta vennad ja õed ei lase tal keskenduda.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Käpapatrull

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Kui Sierra Sädeme suure kontserdi lava vajab rohkem sädelust, kasutab Rubble ja meeskond ehitusraskuseid, et suurt plärtsu teha. Rubble ja meeskond otsustavad tegutseda suurelt, kui müüja Gabriel tahab poe ette midagi erilist ehitada.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Meeskond aitab parkimisprobleemiga, kui Kohviku Carli jäätisemasin toob Ehituslahte palju autosid. Kui Rubble'i pimeduskartus rikub kutsade Hauguaia matka, siis Meeskond leiab lahenduse, et ta saaks tähistaevast nautida.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Nüüd saab Doraga veelgi enam avastada. Liitu ikoonilise Avastaja Doraga imelistel seiklustel koos uute ja vanade sõpradega, kui ta seikleb kummalises ja imelises Vihmametsas koos oma parima sõbra Saapaga

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora on tagasi maagilise vihmametsa veel fantastilistema seiklustega! Liitu silmapaistvaima väikse avastajaga ja ta parima sõbra Saapaga, kui nad lõbutsevad ja leiavad uusi sõpru. Taevas on piiriks. Vamonos!

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbapapa ja Barbamamma naasevad puu juurde, kus nad sündisid. See on halvas seisus. Nad peavad selle kiiresti päästma läheduses asuvaid loomi segamata. On Barbalaste sünnipäev. Nad kõik tahavad Barbapapaga midagi erinevat teha!

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbazoo on valmis aitama, aga Barbabright ja Barbabelle kasutavad ta headust ära ja ajavad ta hulluks. Barbazoo mõistab, et suudab Barbapapat järele teha. Ta kasutab võimalust, et jagada kodutöid vendade ja õdede vahel. Kas nad saavad teada?

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbalapsed arvavad, et toiduga saavad nad värvi ja kuju muuta. Nad otsustavad üksteisele täiusliku toidu leida. Barbabeaul pole inspiratsiooni ega saa enam kunstiga tegeleda. Kogu pere soovitab talle uusi asju, mida maalida.

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbalapsed otsustasid etteaste korraldada ja teevad selleks kõik. Barbalib tahab luua parimat limonaadi.

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbalapsed tahavad leiutada nagu Leonardo da Vinci. Barbalapsed peavad valima basseini ja rattasõidu vahel.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Linnapea Greatway vajab kiiresti palju pitsasid. Aga kui Kiirusemeister kohale saabub, peavad kutsad ta pitsaprobleemi lahendama. Kui pere ei jõua Kiirusemeistri teel õigeks ajaks lennujaama, peab Rubble ja meeskond uue tee ehitama.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Linnapea Greatway ja hr Pardike tahavad teha langevarjuhüppe trikke, aga kui tuul segab, peavad kutsad aitama neil maa peal langevarjuga hüpata. Kui Wheeler ja siga Trühvel ei saa uisutada, peab meeskond leidma ratastel ehituslahenduse.

programme.title: Спецпроект.док
programme.desc: Цикл документальных программ телеканала "Настоящее Время".

programme.title: Перекресток
programme.desc: Сериал, состоящий из короткометражных документальных фильмов, посвященных сложным темам в странах Восточной Европы и Ближнего Востока. Это aвторский взгляд на проблемы и перспективы этих регионов. Настоящая жизнь крупным планом.

programme.title: Реальное кино
programme.desc: Документальный фильм показывает зарубежное наследие Мариуполя, Лисичанска, Дружковки и Нью-Йорка. Съемочная группа обнаружила и оживила уникальные, но малоизвестные архивные материалы Донбасса XIX века. Эксперты, историки и местные жители делятся своими рассказами и свидетельствами об истории региона, которая была тщательно уничтожена и искажена советскими властями. Вскоре после съемок почти все локации были уничтожены российскими ракетами.

programme.title: Настоящее Время. Интервью
programme.desc: Все о чем вы уже вкратце слышали в новостях, но хотели бы узнать подробности. Настоящее Время задает злободневные вопросы ключевым игрокам важных событий, беседует с известными политиками, узнает мнение компетентных аналитиков

programme.title: Глобал
programme.desc: Тележурнал об экологии, возможностях и рисках глобализации. Мы живем в глобальном мире, где, например, климатические изменения тропических лесов Амазонки оказывают влияние на жизнь в Европе. Программа предоставляет дайджесты новейших исследований по вопросам глобализации и экологии, ищет решение для глобальных последствий локальных действий - и наоборот, рассказывает о положительном опыте и примерах в сфере экологии, аграрной или промышленной деятельности других стран.

programme.title: Опасное соседство
programme.desc: Документальный цикл о том, как живут и как чувствуют себя жители независимых государств, соседствующих с РФ, в связи с агрессией России в отношении Украины. Опасаются ли вторжения или гибридного нарушения суверенитета их страны со стороны России? Или, возможно, считают себя частью "русского мира"? С какими проблемами сталкиваются в связи с влиянием на их страну России? Нравится ли им такое соседство и считают ли они его опасным?

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Крым. Реалии
programme.desc: Программа о событиях в Крыму.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Программа "Утро" каждый будний день открывает информационную линейку телеканала "Настоящее Время". "Утро" выходит в прямом эфире из киевской студии и рассказывает зрителям о том, что им надо знать в самом начале дня. Главные новости, основные события наступающего дня, самые важные темы для обсуждения - в утренних эфирах каждый день.

programme.title: Археология
programme.desc: Диалоги о вечных вопросах российской жизни и болевых точках повседневности, о войне и мире. Эти темы Сергей Медведев и его гости обсуждают в программе \"Археология\".

programme.title: Реальное кино
programme.desc: Документальный фильм показывает зарубежное наследие Мариуполя, Лисичанска, Дружковки и Нью-Йорка. programme.title: Балтия
programme.desc: Еженедельная информационная программа "Балтия" – непредвзятый взгляд на происходящее в Эстонии, Латвии и Литве. События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. Точная и беспристрастная информация, все точки зрения о происходящем в каждой из трех стран, входящих в Евросоюз и военный блок НАТО.

programme.title: Сделано в Германии
programme.desc: Программа о бизнесе с человеческим лицом. Захватывающие экономические репортажи из сердца Европы. К примеру, авторы рассказывают о рисках и преимуществах цифровых технологий в быстро меняющемся мире, а также о их влиянии на то, как мы работаем, что мы зарабатываем и как мы живем. Топ-менеджеры, креативные бизнесмены и молодые специалисты, новые тренды и традиции немецкого бизнеса - все это Made in Germany.

programme.title: Однажды в Америке
programme.desc: Это цикл фильмов об эмигрантах, снятый эмигрантом: о людях, которые покинули Украину, Беларусь и Россию после 24 февраля 2022 года. Мы показываем Америку глазами человека, которому нужно строить свою жизнь заново, искать свое место в пока еще чуждом для него мире. Сравниваем цены на продукты и топливо, говорим о политике, работе и учебе.

programme.desc: Документальный фильм показывает зарубежное наследие Мариуполя, Лисичанска, Дружковки и Нью-Йорка. Съемочная группа обнаружила и оживила уникальные, но малоизвестные архивные материалы Донбасса XIX века. Эксперты, историки и местные жители делятся своими рассказами и свидетельствами об истории региона, которая была тщательно уничтожена и искажена советскими властями. Вскоре после съемок почти все локации были уничтожены российскими ракетами.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Программа "Утро" каждый будний день открывает информационную линейку телеканала "Настоящее Время". "Утро" выходит в прямом эфире из киевской студии и рассказывает зрителям о том, что им надо знать в самом начале дня. Главные новости, основные события наступающего дня, самые важные темы для обсуждения - в утренних эфирах каждый день.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Спецпроект.док

programme.title: Документальный час. Америка
programme.desc: Подборка документальных проектов от "Голоса Америки" — о людях, идеях и событиях, которые формируют наше время. Вечные вопросы и острые темы, глубинные конфликты и неожиданные открытия — каждый выпуск предлагает взгляд на мир через призму человеческих историй.

programme.title: Археология
programme.desc: Диалоги о вечных вопросах российской жизни и болевых точках повседневности, о войне и мире. Эти темы Сергей Медведев и его гости обсуждают в программе \"Археология\".

programme.title: Ждем в гости
programme.desc: Это уникальный кулинарно-этнографический телепроект. Ведущий программы путешествует по удивительно красивым и интересным местам, посещая местные достопримечательности, любуясь природой и знакомясь с новыми людьми. Везде гостеприимные хозяева говорят нашим телезрителям: "Ждем в гости!" Вместе с Зурабом Двали вы побываете в разных уголках прекрасной Грузии. В аджарском кафе "Привет из Батума" вам раскроют секрет фирменного салата заведения, директор батумского отеля "Президент-плаза" научит вас готовить осетрину, в самом центре Тбилиси вы узнаете рецепты приготовления традиционных блюд грузинской кухни, в одном из узбекских ресторанов столицы вас посвятят в тайны узбекской кухни, вы побываете на празднике урожая Тбилисоба, винном заводе №1, на даче знаменитой грузинской певицы Ирмы Сохадзе, в Мцхете и Кахетии...

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Лицом к событию

programme.desc: Все о чем вы уже вкратце слышали в новостях, но хотели бы узнать подробности. Настоящее Время задает злободневные вопросы ключевым игрокам важных событий, беседует с известными политиками, узнает мнение компетентных аналитиков

programme.title: VOTVOT
programme.desc: Votvot характеризует себя как платформу для свободного выражения мнений для широкой аудитории, в том числе для молодежи, интересующейся альтернативами традиционным новостным программам. На платформе можно найти среди прочего документальные фильмы, театральные постановки, концерты, детские образовательные программы.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.title: Репортер
programme.desc: Необычные истории из повседневной жизни

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Документальный проект рассказывает о разных американских штатах и городах через истории их жителей, культуру и кухню. Авторы приглашают зрителей за кулисы известных туристских центров и знакомят их с людьми, которые представляют собой коллективный портрет американского общества и демонстрируют лучшие качества американского характера: целеустремленность, инициативность, самодостаточность. Особое внимание в каждом эпизоде будет уделяться предпринимателям, сильным и независимым женщинам, успешным эмигрантам и представителям меньшинств.

programme.title: Смотри в оба
programme.desc: Проект о новостях и тех, кто эти новости делает. О фейках и сенсациях, о невольных ошибках и сознательных манипуляциях. Мы ищем информацию из разных источников, сравниваем и представляем на ваш суд.

programme.title: Kuidas seda selgitada?
programme.desc: Kas Rootsi teismeline pildistas kõige veenvamaid UFO-tõendeid? Kas internetis avaldatud video, mis näitab Idaho kohal lendavat pterodaktülusega sarnanevat olendit, on tõeline? Miks visatakse Atlanta jõkke korduvalt peata kitsi?

programme.title: Oak Islandi needus
programme.desc: Kui reis välismaale loob ühenduse vana maailma ja uue maailma vahel, on meeskond Oak Islandil põnevil, kui uued tõendid näitavad, et kes iganes oli 5. platsil, oli ka sügaval Money Pit'is.

programme.title: William Shatneriga seletamatutes paikades
programme.desc: Hiljuti avastatud iidsed maa-alused ehitised nagu Derinkuyu linn ja Malta Hypogeum viitavad, et maa all võib avastamist oodata veelgi ehitisi. Kui suur osa me minevikust oli maa-alune, kas siis võib seda olla ka me tulevik?

programme.title: Pandikunnid
programme.desc: Muppetite koopiate komplekt muudab Chumi kadedusest roheliseks. Kas karvastest sõpradest vaimustumine toob talle tehingu? Kui poodi jõuavad püksid, mida väidetavalt kandis Keith Richards, õpetab Corey Jake'ile, et alati ei saa seda, mida tahad.

programme.title: Pandikunnid
programme.desc: Rick näeb punast värvi, kui poodi jõuab Rolex Submariner. Kas tema pakkumine lööb laineid või on see lihtsalt ajaraiskamine? Ja hiljem üritab Rick mitte plahvatada rõõmust, kui suundub üle vaatama Boliivia äikesetopside komplekti.

programme.title: Iidsed tulnukad

Ratcatcher
programme.desc: The film opens focused upon James' friend Ryan Quinn, who is being forced to put on his wellington boots to go to visit his father, who is in jail. But Ryan chose to play with James instead, and runs off while his mother is not looking. Ryan meets James at the canal and during some rough-house play he is drowned, clearly with James bearing much of the blame for not having raised the alarm. James believes his inaction has gone unnoticed.

programme.title: An Argentinian Crime
programme.desc: Rosario in the 80s. The disappearance of a man during the military dictatorship. Two young people from the court must do everything possible to solve the case while facing police corruption and various dangers that put their lives at risk.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Tracy Chevalier's best-selling novel, inspired by the Johannes Vermeer painting of the same name. Set in mid-17th-century Delft, Holland, 17-year-old Griet is forced into servanthood when her father suffers an accident and becomes unable to work. She is taken on at the Vermeer household, where her presence immediately provokes hostility from members of the family - particularly the artist's wife and eldest daughter - when she starts to forge an understanding with her mysterious master.

programme.title: Neem Me Mee
programme.desc: Six people over seventy are at a turning point in their lives. Without knowing each other, they go on a journey together.

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: On the eve of her wedding, a young woman meets the love of her life. They decide to spend the whole night together.

programme.title: Diane
programme.desc: Diane fills her days helping others and desperately attempting to bond with her drug-addicted son. As these pieces of her existence begin to fade, she finds herself confronting memories she'd sooner forget than face.

programme.title: The Practice
programme.desc: Gustavo, an Argentine yoga instructor living in Chile who recently lost his wife and home while an injury prevents him from continuing with his yoga practice.

programme.title: Like a Prince
programme.desc: Souleyman, a French boxing champion in preparation for the Olympic Games, sees his future crumble when he cracks the bones of his hand following a bar fight. He is sent to the Château de Chambord, where he must perform community service.

programme.title: Romantics Anonymous
programme.desc: Angélique is a young French woman who suffers from social anxiety disorder and is afraid of just about everything. She regularly attends a support group for other people like her. Jean-René, who owns a small manufacturer of chocolate called the Chocolate Mill, also suffers from social anxiety, and is afraid of many things, particularly intimacy. The Chocolate Mill is failing because it makes a plain, old-fashioned kind of chocolate that no longer sells well.

programme.title: A Clever Crook
programme.desc: Beffrois, a disillusioned police captain nearing retirement, has his curiosity aroused by a new art theft. Seemingly an art specialist, the burglar prefers works of average value. No doubt to avoid attracting attention. Another distinctive sign: he always passes by the roof. For Beffrois the investigation looks to be athletic. Direction, screenplay: Lucas Bernard (France, 2017)

programme.title: S*** in a Good Way
programme.desc: Charlotte couldn't be happier about her relationship with her handsome boyfriend. But during a moment of intimacy, the teen's beau drops a bomb on her: He's gay. She is crushed. So, along with her best friends - the sassy spitfire Megan and the quieter Aube - Charlotte seeks distraction at a toy store. There, the three girls are charmed by the young, male employees and quickly land jobs alongside them. Charlotte, still heartbroken, starts flirting - and having casual sex - with a few of her new coworkers. Initially, she loves her new freedom. Others around her, however, feel differently, leading them to smear Charlotte's name and challenge her newfound sexual empowerment.

programme.title: Chinese Puzzle
programme.desc: Ten years have passed, and the once happy lovers, Xavier Rousseau (Romain Duris) and Wendy (Kelly Reilly), have split. When she moves with their two children to New York City, he also moves to there to be near the children. Wendy now lives with John (Peter Hermann (actor)) in a luxury apartment overlooking Central Park. Xavier initially stays with Isabelle (Cécile de France) and Ju (Sandrine Holt), a lesbian couple whose child he fathered, but he soon finds his own apartment above a Chinese bakery where he works on a new novel assisted by brief visions of Arthur Schopenhauer and Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel.

programme.title: Breakfast on Pluto
programme.desc: Set in the 1970s, "Breakfast on Pluto" follows the exploits of Patrick Braden (Cillian Murphy), an endearing, witty, clever and deceptively tough young transvestite. Abandoned as a baby in his small Irish hometown, Patrick is aware from a very early age that he has been born into the wrong body. He survives this harsh environment with the aid of his wit and charm, plus a sweet refusal to let anyone and anything change who he is. With a burning desire to find his mother and reconciliation, he moves to London, and a hilarious, memorable and emotional series of misadventures sees Patrick, or Kitten as he prefers to be called, finally finding the love and happiness he craves.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: The Unknown Country
programme.desc: Vids reviewed: * The Matrix * Manumission the movie * Another day in paradise * The guide to G spots and multiple orgasms * The six million dollar man * The bionic woman * Human traffic * Jeremy Clarksons Head to head Nige tells us that the car is the modern Black Death. And the guys pay tribute to police squad by doing the freeze frame sketch over the end credits.

programme.title: Ramen Shop
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients.

programme.title: Love Me No More
programme.desc: Antoine Méliot is around 40 years old and has everything he needs to be happy: a beautiful wife, two adorable children, friends he can count on, a pretty house in the Yvelines and money. But one day he decides to ruin everything in one weekend.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: 18th century England. Married at 17 to the rich and powerful Duke of Devonshire, Georgiana quickly charms high society with her stunning beauty, wit and love of life. However, behind this flamboyant image hides a woman who longs to be loved, a woman deserted by her husband - the only man in the kingdom indifferent to her charms - who prefers her best friend Elizabeth Foster, and who obliges her to accept a ménage à trois. Unhappy and unsatisfied, Georgiana leads a hectic social life. Her elegance, her extravagance and her taste for gambling create a sensation, particularly when she throws herself into politics alongside the Liberal Party. She's celebrated by princes and ministers. And she supports the young Member of Parliament, Charles Grey, with whom she falls passionately in love.

programme.title: The Cathedral
programme.desc: An unconventional autobiography, THE CATHEDRAL presents the complex tapestry of conflict-filled family relationships that will shape the life and future filmmaking career of Jesse, a kid growing up in New York from the 1980s to the mid-2000s. The film shows us the life of Jesse and his family at different stages like the chapters of a novel. Ricky D'Ambrose is one of those filmmakers whose style can be described as unique, apart from very specific vignettes, he uses photos, newsreels and TV commercials to convey the world as Jesse experiences it. At the same time, the film is fundamentally a biography of his problematic father, but also of his mother, stepfathers, uncles, aunts, grandparents and great-grandparents - the twisted "cathedral" that built the young man that Jesse would become.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: Drama. French drama, produced in 2010. While in Tuscany to promote his latest book, a middle-aged British writer meets a French gallery owner woman who is also a fan of his books and they set off on a tour of Tuscany.

programme.title: Flash Gordon
programme.desc: Mike Hodges' film is a gloriously kitsch update of the 1930s comic strip and film series, starring Sam J Jones as the American football star Flash Gordon, who's transported, along with the beautiful Dale Arden (Melody Anderson), by Dr Zarkov (Topol) into the realm of the most evil ruler in the universe, the Emperor Ming (Max von Sydow). Only by uniting those under Ming's merciless rule to join his revolution can Flash save Earth from destruction. The unashamedly over-the-top Queen soundtrack is matched by Danilo Donati's effervescent production design, and the film also stars Brian Blessed as the chief of the Hawkmen, Timothy Dalton as the leader of the Treemen, and Ornella Muti as Ming's daughter, whose lascivious designs on Flash are just one of the challenges he must overcome if he's to end Ming's tyranny.

programme.title: The Third Man
programme.desc: Classic film noir about an American writer who visits postwar Vienna to see an old friend, but is told that his friend is dead. Incredulous at the suggestion his friend was a criminal, the writer attempts to clear the dead man's name, but soon finds events taking a strange turn - his friend is very much alive, dealing drugs on the black market.

programme.title: Hidden Beauties
programme.desc: Two young Tunisian women strive for the same emancipation enjoyed by men.

programme.title: Youth
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Harvey Keitel star in this comedy-drama about ageing from Italian director Paolo Sorrentino (The Great Beauty). Retired classical music conductor and composer Fred Ballinger (Caine) is holidaying at a plush hotel in the Swiss Alps with his best friend, the veteran film director Mick Boyle (Keitel). It's supposed to be relaxing, but Ballinger's tranquillity is disturbed by an emissary of the Queen, who wants him to perform one last time for her. Meanwhile, Boyle is fretting because funding for his latest (and, he hopes, greatest) project relies on him securing the participation of his long-time leading lady Brenda Morel (Jane Fonda). The two men also pointedly and ruefully reflect on their lost youth and opportunities; something that's not helped by the current Miss Universe's (Madalina Ghenea) penchant for shedding her clothes whenever she bathes in the hot tub with them. Also starring Rachel Weisz as Ballinger's daughter, who's married to Boyle's son (Tony Dano).

programme.title: The Young Lovers
programme.desc: Elegant, retired architect Shauna (70) crosses paths with Pierre, a happily married doctor in his 40s, who first made an impression on her in a brief meeting 15 years previously. Both are quite troubled to meet again and begin an affair. While Pierre's family life is soon turned upside down, Shauna struggles with feelings she thought belonged to the past.

programme.desc: A war photographer and absent father, who spends more time taking care of his camera than his four daughters, enjoys a happy life in the Alps with his new girlfriend. But his life is turned upside down the day that his best friend tries to reconcilate him with his family by telling them a big lie.

programme.title: Ladies
programme.desc: Lucie is in remission and her illness is almost a distant memory. Her family pushes her to live life to the fullest, and in doing so Lucie meets the charming and arrogant Clovis, who is immediately beguiled by her wit and humor. It is Dalila, however, an eccentric and delightful dance teacher, who inspires Lucie to rebuild her life and to grow into the woman she always wanted to be. For her mother, for her daughter, for Clovis.

programme.title: Vera Drake
programme.desc: Vera Drake is a selfless woman who is completely dedicated to her working class family who love her. He spends his days adoring them, and also takes care of his sick neighbor and old mother. And he secretly visits women and helps them have abortions. Something like that was illegal in England in the 1950s. Vera sees it as helping women in need, and she does it with a smile on her face and words of encouragement. However, when the authorities discover her, Vera's world and family life quickly unravel.

programme.title: Big Nothing
programme.desc: Jean-Baptiste Andrea's dark comedy stars Simon Pegg and David Schwimmer as Gus and Charlie, two workers at a call centre that deals with software problems, who come up with a plan to blackmail pillars of society who are downloading porn. Unfortunately, their plans soon go awry and the body count rises. As Charlie's policewoman wife Penelope (Natascha McElhone) gets too close to the truth, FBI agent Hymes (Jon Polito) closes in from another angle and Gus's ex-girlfriend Josie (Alice Eve) also finds herself involved.

programme.title: Apaches
programme.desc: Renji continues to meets with Chihiro every day after school, though he wonders if he should continue with such a half-hearted attitude. It rains one day after school, so Renji does not go to meet Chihiro, thinking that she would not come under the circumstances, but she comes anyway and manages to catch a cold, something Renji feels terrible about later on. Hiro goes out during school with Miya into town and they have lunch at a café. After Hiro accidentally forgets her given name, Miyako leaves him behind at the café. Kyosuke quits the film club, and even breaks up with his girlfriend.

programme.title: Saint Frances
programme.desc: Critically acclaimed, offbeat comedy-drama written by and starring Kelly O'Sullivan. Thirty-something waiter Bridget (O'Sullivan) finds herself adrift in life. She's yet to begin the career she wants, because she doesn't know what she wants to be. And she's yet to settle down and start a family, because she doesn't know if she wants to get married and be a mum. Indecision rules in Bridget's life. When she takes a summer gig as a nanny for an at times rather demanding six-year-old, Frances (Ramona Edith Williams), Bridget starts learning some important life lessons from the child as well as her two mums, Maya (Charin Alvarez) and Annie (Lily Mojekwu). Sometimes, even the most together of people don't really know what they're doing. And maybe that's OK. Directed by Alex Thompson. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Sharkwrecked: Crash Landing

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. programme.title: Pandamonium

programme.title: Amba the Russian Tiger

programme.title: Gamechangers: Inventing the World
programme.desc: These pioneering gamechangers are working bring a sustainable future to our planet, transforming how we use science, technology and engineering to change societal outlooks. We follow the teams as they work across the entire world, from the deserted Australian outback to the tropical Amazon rainforests, as they design and test these advances in science. Whether it's testing the possibility of survival on Mars, ensuring potable water supplies or reducing carbon emissions, this fascinating documentary series inspires us to change the way we live.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet

programme.title: Tanked

programme.title: Animal Cops: Miami
