programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance: The Other Way
programme.desc: In a spin off of the US series 90 Day Fiance, Americans move to foreign countries to pursue romances and get married. In the original show, partners move into the US on a K-1 visa and have 90 days to settle before the wedding due to the visa process. This spin off sees US citizens applying for their own visas abroad, experiencing culture shocks and leaving behind their entire families for their fiance. These engagements aren't without drama, secrets and lies come to light and relationships are tested to the extreme. Will these Americans find happiness and love abroad, or will they be booking a flight back home?

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of My Feet Are Killing Me: First Steps. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: July 11th, 1991 Preparing to take a group of African-Muslim pilgrims home to Sokoto, Nigeria, Nigerian Airways Flight #2120 takes off from Jeddah's sprawling airport in Saudi Arabia in the blistering desert heat. But once in the air, the pilots get a warning that their plane is not properly pressurizing. With their aircraft losing hydraulics the pilots struggle to turn back towards Jeddah. In the meantime, the cabin fills with heavy smoke and fire. Just two miles from the airport, Flight #2120 erupts into a fireball and plummets to the ground, killing all 261 people on board. The deadliest DC-8 crash in history and the worst accident ever for a Canadian airline, investigators must now determine what went wrong.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana van Zeller follows a meth superhighway from a massive cartel-run lab in Sinaloa across the border and into the lives of American users. Her guide is a wily, meth-smoking dealer whose smuggling empire stretches from coast to coast. Some get rich, some get high, while others wind up dead. It's a hellish tour of an overlooked drug crisis that's burning a hole through America.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Few Americans realize that as much as 30% of the seafood we eat has been caught illegally. Mariana goes inside the global hunt for these fish pirates, who make billions each year while destroying our oceans. Her journey will take her from the ports of Boston and Vigo, Spain, to the west coast of Africa.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: As the debate over America's broken immigration system continues to boil, Mariana heads to Mexico to investigate the billion-dollar business of people smuggling to the US. While following a 2,000-mile trail from Tapachula to the US border, she'll try to understand who's making the money, how the cartels are involved, and why so little is being done to stop it.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether it's a blast from the past, recognizing a long lost pal, or remembering where you parked the car, your memory shapes the story of your life, and allows you to interact with the world around you without everything always seeming strange or unfamiliar. We show you what memory is, why you even have a memory – and why you keep forgetting where you put those darn keys! Play along and you'll also see why, sometimes, forgetting can actually be a good thing.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether you're trying to get to the head of the class, earn the big promotion, or just find a parking spot - every day, you're competing. With yourself… and with others. So what is it about the human brain that makes you want to win - sometimes at all costs? In this episode we'll explore your brain and competition through a series of, well… competitions! Each viewer will be assigned a team and play along as our Red and Blue teams duke it out in a head to head battle to determine the winner of "The Brain Games" . Along the way you'll learn what drives you to compete, why some people may be born more competitive, and how a little healthy rivalry can help you climb the ladder of success. You've got to be in it to win it on Brian Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Why does it seem like men are from Mars and women are from Venus? How can men and women look at the same world and see completely different things? Or solve the same problem two completely different ways? And in a head-to-head matchup of sheer brainpower who wins? This episode of Brain Games will reveal the surprising ways the male and female brain may be different and how its revealed in our behavior and abilities. Your gray matter will be tested through a series of interactive games and unexpected experiments hosted by relatable experts. So its time to choose sides in the ultimate battle of the sexes on Brain Games!

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Lawless Island

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Just minutes before touching down in Portland International Airport, all four engines of a DC-8 mysteriously flame out. With the aircraft dropping 3,000 feet per minute, the pilots realize they have no option but to crash land in the middle of a major American city. Witness the harrowing emergency landing of United Airlines Flight 173 in Portland, Oregon, and uncover the shocking reasons for its massive engine failure.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: One of Russias most popular hockey teams is on its way to Minsk, Belarus, for their first game of the 2011 season. Their Soviet built Yak-42D starts down the main runway at Yaroslavls Tunoshna Airport. But instead of lifting off, the plane runs off the end of the tarmac, strikes a tower and crashes into the Volga River. Only the planes mechanic survives the disaster. Around the globe, fans mourn one of the biggest tragedies in the history of the sport. Russian President Medvedev demands answers, and investigators are under tremendous pressure to find out what went wrong.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: A fire-scarred Great Lakes freighter completes its last journey to a family-run recycling yard on Lake Erie, where turning a dead ship into profit is anything but simple. At MRC's Port Colborne yard, the aging Cuyahoga must be stabilized, stripped and cut apart without contaminating the water or shoreline. Yard manager Jordan Elliott leads a crew working under constant pressure, where time is money and scrap prices can erase profits overnight. The operation hinges on high-risk moments: towing in a powerless ship, navigating brutal financial math, and executing the yard's signature move — using massive rubber airbags to haul the vessel out of the water. It's industrial recycling at full scale, offering a cleaner alternative to global shipbreaking while proving that modern methods can keep steel in circulation without poisoning the future.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: Across southern France, two radically different wind machines pursue the same modern obsession: more speed, more control and almost no margin for error. In Saint-Tropez, SailGP's F50 catamarans — often called Formula One on water — race inches apart on tight courses, where split-second decisions and flawless systems keep disaster at bay. In Leucate, the SP80 team takes a different path, training a kite-powered trimaran built for one purpose only: straight-line speed, with an audacious goal of 150 kilometers per hour. Though their designs diverge, both collide with the same invisible enemy — cavitation. The moment water vaporizes, lift collapses and control vanishes. As sailors, engineers and designers push beyond known limits, wind-driven sport becomes applied engineering, dragging marine technology into an uncertain and faster future.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: By day, maritime authorities conduct high-stakes operations, disrupting the drug trade's resources. As the night falls, relentless chases unfold against traffickers and smugglers. Humanitarian crises intensify under the cover of darkness. Yet, the discovery of an explosive in the port is anything but routine, adding a suspenseful twist to the unfolding drama on the high seas.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: Will you dare to embark with the Huelva Maritime Service to catch dangerous traffickers? Will you join those who set sail for a night shift in Almería to prevent the human trafficking trade? Will you dive into the waters of Girona to defuse undetonated weaponry? Join us on a thrilling journey as we delve into the heart of these daring missions together with the Spanish coastguards.

programme.title: Legal Marijuana in America: The New Green Rush
programme.desc: The war on pot is not over - marijuana is both legal and illicit in America. Penalties and jailtime are still a threat holding back the new cannabis economy as growers, sellers, researchers, and users, all struggle to deal with the changing rules in National Geographic's latest exploration of marijuana laws going legit.

programme.title: Facing...
programme.desc: Facing is a documentary series that tells the stories of a broad range of global iconic, and often notorious, individuals through the eyes and unique experiences of those who 'faced' them - the brave few who dared to oppose the most accomplished and often feared people who have ever lived. And who better to dive into their psyches and peel back the layers of their successes and struggles than the people who helped shaped them through conflict, confrontation, and camaraderie.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: CBP officers in the Port of Savannah intercept a suspiciously heavy shipping container bound for Ghana — and it's full of stolen cars. Officers at New Orleans International Airport question a man arriving from Honduras, after the K-9 enforcement team flags his suitcase as potentially containing narcotics. In Florida, Air and Marine Operations agents patrol a smuggling hotspot, as they search for jettisoned contraband.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: TACA Airlines Flight #110 Boeing 737-300 series May 24th, 1988 Flying through a violent thunderstorm, TACA Flight #110 begins its final descent towards New Orleans when both engines quit and the plane begins dropping from the sky. The pilots restart both engines but almost immediately they overheat forcing the pilots to shut them down. Without power for the second time and falling fast, they consider ditching the plane in a canal but aim instead for a narrow grass levee. With 38 passengers bracing for a crash, the pilots manage one of the most remarkable landings in the history of commercial aviation. Then it's up to investigators to determine why the engines of a brand new Boeing 737 failed in mid-flight.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: SAS Flight #686 Boeing MD-87 October 8th, 2001 A heavy fog blankets Milan's Linate Airport as SAS Flight #686 prepares for a routine flight to Copenhagen. Facing almost zero-visibility, the pilots rely entirely on ground controllers as they navigate into position for takeoff. The plane accelerates down the runway, but as it lifts off it collides with a Cessna in its path. The Cessna erupts in flames. The MD-87 slams to the ground and slides into an baggage hangar. The plane explodes on impact. It is the worst accident in Italian aviation history and the investigation uncovers a shocking series of errors. In the aftermath, an airport is transformed and those deemed responsible are sentenced in court.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP discovers four kilograms of cocaine concealed within two cakes, and then HSI follows the case from Miami to Atlanta to dismantle an interstate smuggling ring. CBP Miami inspects a load of in-transit mail and uncovers two suspicious packages - a drum and machine part - that may contain narcotics. CBP New York cracks-down on the importation of illicit money, and investigates multiple travelers attempting to bring-in large sums of undeclared cash.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: U.S. Border Patrol agents in Puerto Rico deal a significant blow to a known drug trafficking organization when they intercept a boat carrying 201 kilos of cocaine worth $2 million and two bags of weapons and ammunition. In Gulfport, Mississippi, agents police the I-10, a prime route for smugglers trafficking contraband across the South. Meanwhile, marine agents in Florida patrol busy waters crowded with weekend boaters, on high alert for any illegal activity.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Marine agents in Fort Lauderdale are on the hunt for a large shipment of drugs leaving the U.S. With the help of the U.S Coast Guard, they successfully intercept a boat found to be carrying 10 pounds of marijuana. In Gulfport, Mississippi, U.S. Border Patrol agents police the I-10, a notorious smuggling route. Meanwhile, agents patrol the waters for smugglers bringing in illicit goods under the cover of darkness.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat, cocaine smuggling. A woman is caught trafficking cocaine inside packets of hair bleach. When she's hit with a dramatic fainting spell, officers fear the worst. Agents uncover nearly three kilos of cocaine inside photos of the Pope. And a man who attempted to run from police is arrested, his luggage lined with cocaine.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat, cocaine smuggling. Agents arrest two different traffickers with bricks of cocaine branded in the same curious way. One of those loads is among the largest of the last few years. Panicked asylum seekers refuse to cooperate, causing an uproar. And suitcases carrying hundreds of counterfeit goods are intercepted.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: TACA Airlines Flight #110 Boeing 737-300 series May 24th, 1988 Flying through a violent thunderstorm, TACA Flight #110 begins its final descent towards New Orleans when both engines quit and the plane begins dropping from the sky. The pilots restart both engines but almost immediately they overheat forcing the pilots to shut them down. Without power for the second time and falling fast, they consider ditching the plane in a canal but aim instead for a narrow grass levee. With 38 passengers bracing for a crash, the pilots manage one of the most remarkable landings in the history of commercial aviation. Then it's up to investigators to determine why the engines of a brand new Boeing 737 failed in mid-flight.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: SAS Flight #686 Boeing MD-87 October 8th, 2001 A heavy fog blankets Milan's Linate Airport as SAS Flight #686 prepares for a routine flight to Copenhagen. Facing almost zero-visibility, the pilots rely entirely on ground controllers as they navigate into position for takeoff. The plane accelerates down the runway, but as it lifts off it collides with a Cessna in its path. The Cessna erupts in flames. The MD-87 slams to the ground and slides into an baggage hangar. The plane explodes on impact. It is the worst accident in Italian aviation history and the investigation uncovers a shocking series of errors. In the aftermath, an airport is transformed and those deemed responsible are sentenced in court.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: With flames emerging through the cockpit floor, the pilots of Pilgrim Airlines 458 are desperate to land. Amid smoke, extreme heat and zero visibility, they somehow manage to touch down on a frozen Rhode Island reservoir. Within minutes, the inferno destroys any evidence of how the fire started. And with no data recorder, it's a surviving pilot who ultimatley gives investigators the break they need.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Over 750,000 cars are stolen each year in the United States - one every 42 seconds - with many of them headed overseas. Mariana chases down the players profiting the most from this surprising transcontinental supply chain.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: In the world of cocaine trafficking, the favelas of Rio and the mountains of Colombia are hallowed ground. But, what appears as an investigation into smuggling networks is actually a journey with a more specific focus. It's not only the drugs that have caught Mariana's attention. It's a new breed of narco that is starting to gain power in the shadows: las jefas, lady bosses.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Fentanyl has turbocharged the deadliest drug crisis in American history. But less understood is how the drug has utterly transformed the black market. Mariana goes in search of the new bosses, new routes, new risks and the American communities paying the price for fentanyl's next wave.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode we're busting some widely held myths and figuring out why the brain believes them. Everyone knows that alcohol kills brain cells, your IQ is a fixed number you're born with, and we use only 10 percent of our brains...Right? Well, not quite. These beliefs are misconceptions perpetuated by popular opinion. This raises some questions: How much of what we think we know is actually true?

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Are you stuck with the brain you're born with, or can you improve it? It's easy to upgrade the electronic devices you rely on every day; can you do the same with your brain? The answer might surprise you. This episode of Brain Games puts your brain to the ultimate test with a series of interactive games and fascinating experiments that reveal its hidden mental shortcuts, and how to give it a performance boost. Prepare to retrain your brain - on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Scientists have found that optical illusions are one of the best ways to get inside your head to see how your brain works. Through a series of fun, interactive games and illusions we'll play a few tricks on your eyes to show you how your brain builds your reality. You'll learn an easy way to turn beautiful celebrities into ugly monsters using only your mind, and how you can shrink a 6' 4"" man to half his height. Get ready to see why you shouldn't always believe your eyes - on Brain Games.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: During the brutal winter season, residents of Port Protection must ensure their safety at all costs. As members of the Volunteer Fire Department, Sam Carlson, Dave Squibb, and Stuart Andrews must carry out an emergency fire drill. Curly Leach teaches Mary Miller the art of trapping. Gary Muehlberger enlists help to make vital repairs to his fishing boat. And Matt Carlson and Kaylee Burk take their daughter on a scouting mission for key resources.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Colossal Machines
programme.desc: In this programme, we examine the science behind some of the world's most impressive, technologically advanced machines. What big ideas drove their evolution? How do they actually work? What sets each machine apart? Follow along for all the fascinating stories as we reveal the best-kept mechanical secrets that not only made these extraordinary machines work, but also changed the world in a big way.

programme.title: Colossal Machines
programme.desc: The need for speed has been met with a new superclass of machines. It is expected that they will have to go farther, higher and, most of all, faster. Experts investigate the construction and design of some of the most incredible speed machines in the world.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: Frigid temperatures wreak havoc on Dawson City. A midnight call to a truck fire in -30°C weather finds the crew fighting to extinguish the flames and rescue the driver. Later, the cold snap bursts pipes across town, and Chief Mike's team must put their fears aside as they respond to a toxic gas leak. Meanwhile, Yukon communities near the Klondike Highway are cut off from supplies after an avalanche shuts down the main throughway. Avalanche technician Colin takes to the air to break up the snowpack, but when his bombs bounce off the dense, frozen snow, he's forced to come up with a new plan to open up the road.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: In the dead of night, the Dawson City Fire Department receives multiple 911 calls, sending the small crew of volunteers into action to save a historic building and a family home. Pushed to the brink and stretched thin, Chief Mike embarks on a mission to be better prepared to protect Dawson's community and history from the worst-case scenario. In Whitehorse, a series of snowstorms torments the city. As the sun sets, a snowmobiler stuck in deep snow makes a desperate call for help. Helicopter pilot Adam Fox faces the challenge of getting the citizen and the snowmobile to safety. Meanwhile, out on the highway, icy conditions send a vehicle careening off the road, and Ray's life is in jeopardy as he attempts to retrieve it alone.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue 10
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In Overhalla, Jo Roger's under pressure when a crashed truck blocks the main road north-south. With no alternative routes, the crash cuts Norway in two. In the south, a truck parked up for the night starts sliding on sheet ice. During the rescue, Thord discovers that the accident could have been much worse, because the truck was close to careering down a steep bank when the driver was asleep. Thord's young recruit Gabriel also gets a shock during his first solo mission. Called out to rescue a car that's slammed into a cliff face, he realises that the car is a write-off - but is then surprised to find the four occupants in party mood.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: United Airlines Flight #232 DC-10 July 19th, 1989 United Airlines Flight #232 is 37,000 feet over Iowa when one of its three engines explodes. The pilots shut it down but soon discover they have a much more serious problem on their hands. The plane is in a steep right bank, and the pilots are unable to restore its flight path. The DC-10 has suffered a complete failure of all hydraulic systems, and the pilots have no way to maneuver the plane other than by alternating the power to the two remaining engines. The pilots manage to fly the crippled plane to the nearest airport but, unable to configure the wings for a normal landing, they have no choice but to keep the engines at nearly full power. After a crash that claims 111 of the 296 people on board, it's up to investigators to figure out how a foolproof system failed.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The Lockheed Electra was the workhorse of Reeve Aleutian Airways, one of the few links from Cold Bay, Alaska, to the outside world. But on June 8, 1983, the plane nearly plunged 19,000 feet into the Pacific Ocean after one of its propellers tore from the aircraft and cut a hole through the cabin. Join us as we document this incredible story of survival, from the cockpit to the cabin, with witness accounts, official records, and dramatic recreations.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: Battle for Alaska's Oil
programme.desc: The battle for oil in Alaska's Arctic National Wildlife Refuge has waged for over 40 years. Environmental and ingenuous groups fight to preserve the 19 million acres of wilderness home to caribou, birds, and polar bears. But it's the oil potentially hidden underneath that corporations are after. National Geographic investigates the battle for oil in Arctic Alaska.

In the southern mountains, Bjørn and his wife Anette are called out to recover a stranded car after two tourists stray onto a cross-country ski track. And Thord gets angry when a truck driver ignores his advice and wants the rescue done on the cheap.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue 10
programme.desc: A tanker truck full of waste slides back on a narrow, icy hill, almost slamming into a snow-covered car. It's a tight spot, forcing Thord to use his lightweight pick-up - but one slip risks turning this rescue into a disaster. In Overhalla, tow-trucker Marius stops by Jo Roger's garage on a road trip south. But when the visit gets interrupted by an emergency call, Jo Roger invites Marius to join the rescue. What was a ten-minute coffee break turns into a hard night's work.

programme.title: Extreme Rescues
programme.desc: Extreme Rescues tells dramatic real-life stories from across the globe using footage captured by the rescuers themselves. In this episode a novice caver is trapped in a flooding passage, a rescue team fights through a storm to reach an injured fisherman, and snowboarders race against time as they try to find their friend buried in an avalanche.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Its not enough for Earth to be habitable, it also has to be lethal for life to thrive. Death is hardwired into everything from our cells to the planet itself. Global mass extinctions create the opportunities which evolution seizes; boosting the biodiversity needed to survive whatever the planet throws at it. And at the heart of this story is a biological superpower - sex - lifes trade off with death to survive on a restless world.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Astronaut Chris Hadfield has left the planet three times already, now he wants to do more. After seeing the bullet holes left by asteroids on our planet's surface, he believes our only chance of survival is to escape Earth and build a colony off-world. But it will be the toughest journey humanity has ever faced: space radiation, microgravity and the bacteria inside us will conspire against us. So could we earthlings ever survive off our one strange rock?

programme.title: Science of Stupid

We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. In this episode we learn just how many ways there are to embarrass, injure and humiliate yourself when BASE jumping, pulling a BMX nose wheelie and showing off your sword skills.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Your mind and body are connected in countless ways, and some are more mysterious than others. In this episode, you'll discover how your mind and body sometimes work together like the best of friends - and how they sometimes betray each other like the worst of enemies. You'll see two professional mixed marital arts fighters challenged like never before, and you'll have a chance to go head-to-head against them in a game that looks easy but will leave you all thumbs. Finally, you'll learn a secret about your body's reaction time that you can use to make a quick buck. Get ready to wrap your brains around your body… on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Think youre in charge of your own destiny? Do you believe the decisions you make are rational? Do you consider yourself good at weighing the options? Think again. This episode of Brain Games puts your decision-making process to the ultimate test with a series of fast-paced interactive games, surprising experiments, and a team of experts to prove that the decisions you make every day are not as reliable as you think and how you can you put yourself back in the drivers seat.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Brand new: Car S.O.S is back with a new series, as Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend restore more classic cars for deserving owners and approach their 100th restoration. In this first episode, Tim and Fuzz head to Wellingborough to pick up a 1988 Fiat Uno Turbo, one of the fastest hatchbacks of its time. The car belongs to car salesman Gerry, a dyed-in-the-wool boy racer. Sadly, Gerry's ill health has meant that the Uno has been tucked away and left to rot on his drive. His friends and family hope the boys' treatment can bring some joy back into Gerry's life.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Huddersfield to rescue a 1992 VW Corrado, a German coupe that in its time was one of the fastest small family cars on the road. The car belongs to 37-year-old Ashley, a dyed in the wool petrolhead who even went as far as changing his surname to match his car. Sadly, when Ashley fell ill, his car ended up rotting away under a cover. His wife Kristina hopes a fully restored Corrado is exactly what her hubbie needs to bring some good fortune back into his life.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz travel to Jersey in the Channel Islands to take on a 1972 Ford Escort Mexico. Owner Gary has been recovering from a horrific spell of ill health, having been struck down with both blood cancer and tuberculosis, and his family hope that his restored classic will give him a new lease of life. Once the boys get the car back to the workshop they quickly realise that not one single part of the car is salvageable.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz travel to Manchester to secretly steal away Stephen's 1983 Citroen 2CV, a quirky French economy car that was once the pride and joy of owner Stephen. When the boys arrive to steal the car away they discover that it has been stripped down to its component parts and looks more like a jigsaw than a car. Owner Stephen has been suffering from stage 4 throat cancer and his family hope that getting his 2CV back on the road will help give him a new lease of life.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Master mechanics Fuzz Townshend and parts-blagging petrol head Tim Shaw are back for a brand new season of the fan favourite show Car S.O.S. The comedy duo have their work-cut out as they embark on more undercover missions rescuing classic cars and returning them in a surprise reveal to their much deserving owners. This season starts with a exhaust bang, as Tim and Fuzz are on a special mission to rescue a unique classic racing car and reunite it with a true racing legend...Sir Stirling Moss! But this 1962 Austin Healy Sebring Sprite, that once raced in a team that included Sir Stirling Moss, isn't in a fit state. But the guys have a plan to get this car back on the racetrack and Sir Stirling Moss back in the driving seat. Fuzz begins work in the garage whilst Tim goes in search of the original engine, and also finding time along the way to have a sit down with the racing legend himself. Will the Sprite be ready in time for Sir Stirling Moss to take it out for a spin? The guys also come across a supercar that's begging to be taken back to the swinging '60s, the Jaguar E-type. But the car's owner Mick is suffering from osteoporosis and has lost all hope that his beloved car will ever be back to its full glory. But Tim and Fuzz are working with Mick's family in secret to restore the car and give Mick a brilliant surprise. But when they discover it's a back to metal restoration this car looks like it's going to be more of a head-ache than a head-turner. Other cars festering away waiting for the guy's attention are Tim's all-time favourite: the Audi Quattro Turbo, the 3 wheeled 1934 Morgan F4, a retro 1982 Mk1 GTI and a 1995 Nissan Skyline GTR. So start up those engines, as Tim and Fuzz return this month for the ultimate car show with a heart.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam Central Station is a haven for the homeless. Due to a housing shortage, migration, and long wait times for mental health services, around 100 people hang around the station every day. Field workers Marieke and Fikret try to help people with ID, shelter, or a train ticket home. But that's not easy: many homeless people refuse to be helped. Warehouse worker Ron is at odds with the deposit machines in the station. Law enforcement officers Menno and Baran are dealing with an aggressive can collector. Manager Mike shows off the world's largest underground bicycle parking facility. On the day the so-called "orphan bikes" are collected—bikes that haven't been picked up after a month—he and his team have to step up their efforts. And that's not the only bicycle parking facility; a new one is being built under the railway line.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: SAIL Amsterdam is the largest nautical event in the world, held in the capital once every five years. Around 800 historic ships and impressive tall ships sail along the IJ River past Amsterdam Central Station. Amsterdam Central Station staff expects an additional 150,000 passengers, making it one of the busiest days of the year. To ensure the enormous influx of visitors doesn't lead to dangerous congestion, station manager René and safety coordinator Bas oversee crowd control. They have to pull out all the stops, especially after the fireworks show ends in the evening. For the Safety & Service team, it's all hands on deck. Menno and Baran are busy dealing with alcohol-related incidents of collapse and aggression.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: In this special episode, we'll take you on a spectacular aerial tour of Europe's most astounding agricultural advancements, as you've never seen before. From above, we'll visit some of the most breathtaking regions across all of Europe, from the Greek Islands to the Mediterranean, across Lapland to the Polish Riviera and more. Our flying cameras uncover a jaw-dropping island with a uniquely Greek harvest, a traditional winter migration of Highland cattle, and a vibrant flower parade in the Spanish city of Valencia. We'll introduce you to the pioneers behind these agricultural traditions and how they connect the communities across Europe.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: In this special episode, we'll take a spectacular aerial tour highlighting Europe's engineering prowess from a vantage point that is rarely seen. From above, we'll visit some of the most visually stunning regions across all of Europe. Our flying cameras unveil the impenetrable defenses of Wales's biggest castle, a jaw-dropping window cleaning operation in Benidorm, Europe's foremost astronomical observatory, the construction of the continent's largest snow village, and a giant bridge traveling across the sea. We'll introduce you to the innovators responsible for maintaining these structures and how these engineering masterpieces have shaped the European communities you see today.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: U.S. Border Patrol agents in Puerto Rico deal a significant blow to a known drug trafficking organization when they intercept a boat carrying 201 kilos of cocaine worth $2 million and two bags of weapons and ammunition. In Gulfport, Mississippi, agents police the I-10, a prime route for smugglers trafficking contraband across the South. Meanwhile, marine agents in Florida patrol busy waters crowded with weekend boaters, on high alert for any illegal activity.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The world's most famous football team, Manchester United, is on its way back to the UK from the European Championships in Yugoslavia. And after a refueling stop in Munich, the pilots prepare for the final leg of their journey home. In light snow, the aircraft careers down the runway, but just as it approaches takeoff speed, the plane suddenly slows down and, without lifting off the ground, crashes into a nearby house and fuel shed. With 23 people dead, including seven Manchester United players, the high-profile air disaster effectively wipes out one of the best football teams in the world. With the international media clamoring for answers, the German inquiry begins piecing together what went wrong. And when the surviving pilot is blamed for the crash, his struggle to clear his name spans more than a decade and pits one nation against another.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Northwest Airlines Flight #85 Boeing 747-400 Northwest Airlines Flight #85 is halfway between Detroit and Japan's Narita Airport. With more than 400 people on board, the Boeing 747 is cruising 35,000 feet above the Bering Sea when suddenly the aircraft lurches violently to the left and begins losing altitude. The pilots manage to level out the plane but have difficulty controlling the crippled and shaking aircraft. After declaring an emergency, they turn around in the hopes of reaching Anchorage, 1300 kilometers away. Nearly two hours later, the terrifying ordeal ends when the plane touches down safely. The skilled pilots have narrowly saved a 747 from a fatal crash. Now it's up to investigators to determine what caused them to lose control of the plane in the first place.

programme.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to Hudson Bay in Arctic Canada to check in on some old friends: a pack of wolves led by their fearless leader, Kona. Winter is their most punishing season. Food is scarce, forcing the pack to take on their biggest and most dangerous prey, the moose. Facing an animal 10 times their size, one wrong move could be fatal. It's this battle of size versus strategy that Bertie has come to film. What he witnesses and captures is a rarely seen event — and an unforgettable moment for a member of his favorite pack.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: From "The Lion King" director Jon Favreau and BBC Studios executive producer Mike Gunton comes the extraordinary true story of a lion cub named Kio on his epic journey to become a king. Filmed over four years, this sweeping saga of family, hope and courage follows Kio as he grows from a vulnerable cub into a powerful leader. Along the way, he faces loss, exile and fierce rivals in a fight to survive. Combining cinematic storytelling with groundbreaking natural history filmmaking, this series captures the complete coming-of-age story of a lion — and the remarkable making of a king.

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: Crystal Skulls - mysterious artefacts found around the world that have captured the imagination of new age enthusiasts and esteemed academics alike. One skull in particular has long been the source of controversy and intrigue. The Truth Behind Crystal Skulls looks specifically at the provenance of the Mitchell-Hedges Crystal Skull, claimed to have been discovered in Belize in the early 20th Century. The program answers the questions that continue to mystify its proponents. Is it a contemporary object of art? Is it an ancient Mayan artefact dating to over 3000 years ago? This adventurous documentary finds the answers by delving in to the murky past of the skull and taking us on a journey through the streets of Beijing, the jungle of Belize and the cities of Washington DC and London UK to discover the truth.

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: UFO's. Everyone's heard about them - but what are they exactly? The Truth Behind travels to the unofficial UFO capital of the world to investigate. Charting the rise of UFO sightings from the 1940's to the present day, the investigation examines the conspiracy theories, conducts a stakeout in the desert, looks into a recent sighting, and takes a field trip to a crash site in Nevada might unearth some clues. We'll hear the experiences of a man who's flown in a real flying saucer and has got the footage to prove it. All to find the Truth Behind UFOs.

programme.title: Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths
programme.desc: The notion of demons have been with humankind for centuries. They stretch back to the ancient world and the early church, but its in 1600s France that a convent experiences one of the most extraordinary cases of mass possession. In the Victorian era two sisters become famous for channeling spirits. In the twentieth century exorcism becomes a blockbuster film and the "Satanic Panic" fuels widespread conspiracies.

programme.title: Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths
programme.desc: The history of werewolves takes us back to ancient beliefs regardin man and wolf but it's in the 16th century that a killing spree sees werewolves enter the courtoom. At the French court, the werewolf is reborn as a cautionary fary tale. The longstanding vilification of wolves and animal behaviour shapes the legend and mass media sends the myth into overdrive.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Chess-playing computers are nothing new today, but how did a robot beat the world's best chess players back in 1770? Is this the world's first artificial intelligence, or is there sleight of hand at play? Charles Lindbergh was arguably the world's most famous man in the 1930s, as the first to fly non-stop across the Atlantic and then have his son tragically kidnapped. Lesser known is his invention of a singular glass pump of elegant design. What is it for? A 2,400-year-old mummy is brought from Egypt to Croatia by a collector. Only after it is donated to a museum does anyone realize that this mummy is wrapped in the rarest remnant of a lost language. The writing on the wrappings is pored over by experts to decipher it. What does it say?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Towering 13 feet tall and over 11,000 years old, the Vulture Stone is a mysterious message from the end of the Ice Age, one of many relief carvings found at the site of Göbekli Tepe in Turkey. What can its strange depictions of birds, a scorpion and a headless man mean? A disturbing dome-like mask with a box where the mouth should be is the legacy of 1920s' inventor and sci-fi writer Hugo Gernsback. His goal was peace and quiet on demand, but did he instead pre-empt the medical and torture applications of sensory deprivation? In a Swiss church stands a fearsome skeleton clothed in a suit of armor that is as exotic as it is impractical. Who would go to the trouble of creating such an ornately macabre work of art, and whose skeleton is it?

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In Overhalla, there's double-trouble. Jo Roger goes to an all-night rescue of a fifty-one tonner carrying steel bars, but his team risks defeat when their towing gear shatters in extreme cold - and Raido fights time when called to remove a truck that blocks a busy route to a ferry terminal. In the southern mountains, Bjørn and his wife Anette are called out to recover a stranded car after two tourists stray onto a cross-country ski track. And Thord gets angry when a truck driver ignores his advice and wants the rescue done on the cheap.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue 10
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: Frigid temperatures wreak havoc on Dawson City. A midnight call to a truck fire in -30°C weather finds the crew fighting to extinguish the flames and rescue the driver. Later, the cold snap bursts pipes across town, and Chief Mike's team must put their fears aside as they respond to a toxic gas leak. Meanwhile, Yukon communities near the Klondike Highway are cut off from supplies after an avalanche shuts down the main throughway. Avalanche technician Colin takes to the air to break up the snowpack, but when his bombs bounce off the dense, frozen snow, he's forced to come up with a new plan to open up the road.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: In the dead of night, the Dawson City Fire Department receives multiple 911 calls, sending the small crew of volunteers into action to save a historic building and a family home. Pushed to the brink and stretched thin, Chief Mike embarks on a mission to be better prepared to protect Dawson's community and history from the worst-case scenario. In Whitehorse, a series of snowstorms torments the city. As the sun sets, a snowmobiler stuck in deep snow makes a desperate call for help. Helicopter pilot Adam Fox faces the challenge of getting the citizen and the snowmobile to safety. Meanwhile, out on the highway, icy conditions send a vehicle careening off the road, and Ray's life is in jeopardy as he attempts to retrieve it alone.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP discovers four kilograms of cocaine concealed within two cakes, and then HSI follows the case from Miami to Atlanta to dismantle an interstate smuggling ring. CBP Miami inspects a load of in-transit mail and uncovers two suspicious packages - a drum and machine part - that may contain narcotics. CBP New York cracks-down on the importation of illicit money, and investigates multiple travelers attempting to bring-in large sums of undeclared cash.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Partizan - Valencia
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Hong Kong/ USA 2018 põnevik/ märul Lavastaja:Pierre Morel Osades:Jennifer Garner, John Gallagher Jr., John Ortiz "Piparmünt" on märulitriller, mis jutustab loo noorest emast Riley Northist (Jennifer Garner, seriaal "Alias"), kes ärkab koomast pärast perele osaks saanud ränka rünnakut, mille käigus hukkusid ta abikaasa ja tütar. Kuna süsteem on võtnud mõrvarid oma kaitse alla, otsustab Riley ise asuda linnagerilja teele. Ammutades motivatsiooni teda valdavast frustratsioonist ja ebaõiglustundest, treenib ta aastaid oma mõistust, keha ja vaimu ning muutub pidurdamatuks jõuks, jäädes kättesaamatuks nii allmaailmategelaste, politseijõudude kui ka FBI jaoks ning naisest saab omapärane õiglust tarniv bränd.

programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson satub vastamisi oma vihavaenlasega - mägraga. Jeremy kardab oma tervise pärast.

programme.title: Oceani kolmteist
programme.desc: Kassahittide triloogia kolmas osa, milles Danny Ocean ja tema kamp on nõus Las Vegases ette võtma oma seni kõige riskantsema operatsiooni vaid ühel põhjusel - et kaitsta üht omade seast. Kui halastamatu kasiinoomanik Willy Bank Reuben Tishkoffi haiglasse saadab, tulevad Danny ja poisid jälle kokku, et näha, kas neil õnnestub pank lõhki ajada. Põhimõttel "vaenlase vaenlane on sõber" saavad nad liitlaseks ka oma kunagise vihavaenlase Terry Benedicti ning eriti kõrgete panustega mäng võib alata.

programme.title: Piire ületades
programme.desc: USA 2014 ulmepõnevik Lavastaja: Wally Pfister Osades: Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall, Paul Bettany Dr Will Caster (Johnny Depp) on juhtiv teadlane tehisintellekti valdkonnas, kelle eesmärgiks on luua teadvust omav masin, kes kannaks endas nii kogu inimkonna poolt läbi aegade ammutatud infot kui ka kõiki inimemotsioone. Ta ülimalt vastuolulised katsed on talle kuulsust toonud, ent samas teinud tast ka tehnoloogiavastaste äärmuslaste peamise sihtmärgi. Nood teevad kõik, et teda peatada. Ent püüdes Willi hävitada, sunnivad äärmuslased tahtmatult teda hoopis edu nimel suuremat ohvrit tooma - ta otsustab end katsejänesena üleloomulikuks moondada. Ta naise Evelyni (Rebecca Hall) ja parima sõbra Max Watersi (Paul Bettany) jaoks, kes töötavad mõlemad sama projekti kallal, pole küsimus selles, kas nad suudavad seda teha, vaid selles, kas nad peaksid seda tegema. Nende suurimad kartused saavad tõeks, kui Willi teadmisjanu muutub näiliselt kõikehaaravaks võimuihaks, mille tagajärgi on võimatu ette aimata. Hirmutava tõsiasjana ilmneb vaid see, et teda võib olla võimatu peatada.

programme.title: Üüratu talendi talumatu taak
programme.desc: Oscari-võitja Nicolas Cage kehastab märulikomöödias "Üüratu talendi talumatu taak" Nick Cage'i. Tööpuuduses ja pankrotiga silmitsi seisev Cage'i filmiversioon võtab vastu miljon dollarit ja osaleb ohtliku superfänni (Pedro Pascal, "Wonder Woman 1984") sünnipäeval. Olukord võtab aga ootamatu pöörde, kui CIA agent (Tiffany Haddish, "Õhtukool") Cage'i värbab. Ta peab enda ja oma kallimate päästmiseks kasutama oma tuntumate ja armastatuimate ekraanikangelaste oskusi. Autasustatud näitleja karjäär viiski selle hetkeni, mil tal tuleb täita elu suurimat rolli ja mängida Nicolas Cage'i.

programme.title: Spartacus
programme.desc: Spartacus soovitab oma püsimatutele mässulistele ennast treenida, et olla valmis pühamu kaitsmiseks. Lucretia ja Ilithyia otsivad teineteiselt lohutust. Glaber kasvatab oma vägesid uute nekrutite palkamisega.

programme.desc: Nurjunud teemantivarguse järel kogunevad vargad lattu, kus kasvav kahtlus reeturi suhtes viib vägivalla ja kaoseni.

programme.title: Spartacus
programme.desc: Spartacus ja tema mässulised üritavad oma ridu kasvatada võõrsõdades vangistatud võitlejaid vabastades. Lucretia püüab värvata ühte oma abikaasa endistest gladiaatoritest, et roomlased üle kavaldada.

programme.title: Seks ja linn 2
programme.desc: Ülemaailmse kassahiti järg on teravmeelne romantiline komöödia, mille aluseks samanimeline menuseriaal. Carrie, Samantha, Charlotte ja Miranda on tagasi, et astuda vastu uutele väljakutsetele, mida meeste ja naiste omavahelised suhted pidevalt esitavad. Mis juhtub pärast seda, kui öeldakse altari ees "jah"? Elu pakub kõike seda, mida need neli naist eales tahta oskasid, aga saatusel on alati varuks mõni üllatus. Käesoleval juhul on selleks glamuurne ja päikeseküllane seiklus ühte kõige luksuslikumasse ja elavamasse paika maamuna peal, kus pidu ei lõpe iial. Selline põgenemine reaalsuse eest tuleb nelja parima sõbra jaoks just õigel hetkel, kui nad katsuvad jõudu erinevate rollidega nagu ema, abikaasa ja palju muudki. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Supercross Tallinn 2026
programme.desc: 2026. aasta novembri keskel toimus Unibet Arenal juba teist aastat järjest Supercross Tallinn. Rahvusvaheline mõõduvõtt tõi kokku 24 sportlast kolmeteistkümnest riigist. Saates näeb lisaks võidusõidule ka motokaskadööride ning ühe maailma parima slacklineri etteasteid ning suurüritusega kaasnevat melu, millest said osa ligemale 6000 pealtvaatajat.

programme.title: Täheks sündinud
programme.desc: Kas täiesti tavalisest inimesest võib meie kõigi silme all vaid mõne sekundiga saada tõeline superstaar? Jüri Butšakovi juhitud suurejoonelises muusikashows saavad superfännid võimaluse kehastuda oma armastatud iidoliks. Kolmandas eelvoorus astuvad lavale Jaagup Kreem, Ines, Ed Sheeran ja Maria Callas. Esitusi hindavad kohtunikud Stig Rästa, Elina Nechayeva, Peeter Oja ning Synne Valtri, kes otsustavad, milline kolmik tegi kõige vägevama etteaste.

Narr, Animal Mother ja paljud teised noorsõdurid paisatakse põrgulikku laagrisse, mida juhtiv sadistlik seersant suhtub neisse kui armetusse kõntsa. Täielik alandus on esimene samm teel, mis peab poisid tundetuteks tapamasinateks vormima...

programme.title: Grand Tour
programme.desc: Saatejuhid saavad ülesande muuta autod sotsiaalmeedia abiga noortele atraktiivsemaks. Kellel õnnestub kõige rohkem paparatsosid kokku meelitada? Eboladroomil võtavad mõõtu 8ondate Itaalia superautod Ferrari testarossa ja Lamborghini Countach LP5000. Kolmik selgitab välja ka parima uue kiire luukpära - VW Polo GTI.

programme.title: Killerid
programme.desc: Kassahitist möllukomöödia Spencer Aimesist, kes on täiesti tavaline valitsuse superpalgamõrvar, kelle elu keerleb Euroopa eksootiliste klubide, maitselagedate sportautode ja veelgi maitsetumate naiste ümber. Kohates Jen Kornfeldti, kaunist ja valusast lahkuminekust toibuvat arvutispetsi, on Spencer leidnud tõelise armastuse ning vahetab rahvusvahelise karjääri suurima heameelega koduse õndsuse vastu. Kolm aastat hiljem naudivad Spencer ja Jen endiselt oma täiuslikku abielu, seda kuni Spenceri 30. sünnipäeva hommikuni, mil noored saavad teada, et Spenceri eest on välja pandud tõeliselt kopsakas pearaha...

programme.title: Saatuslik naine
programme.desc: Eduka spordiagendi Derricki (Michael Ealy) täiuslik elu saab metsiku üheöösuhte järel läbi. Nimelt osutub seksikas ja salapärane naine, kelle nimel ta kõigega riskis, sihikindlaks politseiuurijaks (Hilary Swank), kes ta oma uusimasse juurdlusesse segab. Üritades meeleheitlikult toimuvas selgust saada, langeb Derrick aina sügavamale naise lõksu ja seab nii ohtu oma pere, karjääri ja isegi elu. "Saatuslik naine" on pingeline psühholoogiline põnevik ja ettearvamatu kassi-hiire mäng, kus üks viga võib elu muuta.

Legends of this particular sport include Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.

programme.title: Basketball: NCAA. Illinois - Duke
programme.desc: Packed arenas seating tens of thousands of spectators, battles fought not only for victory but also for honor, overflowing excitement, and that time of year when all of America seems to lose its mind: March. This is the NCAA. This is U.S. college basketball.

programme.title: Ice Hockey: Switzerland National League. Zug - Ajoie
programme.desc: The National League is a professional ice hockey league in Switzerland and is the top tier of the Swiss league system.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Partizan - Valencia
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: GP Confidential

programme.desc: Vana-Egiptuse viimane kuninganna Kleopatra VII kehastas Egiptuse langemist Rooma alla. See episood uurib tema surma taga olevat tõde, mis on tekitanud ajaloolaste seas pingsat arutelu.

programme.title: Hitleri mängud värvilisena: Berliin 1936
programme.desc: 1936. aasta Berliini olümpiamängud tõid kaasa suuri uuendusi, sh mängude esimesed teleülekanded ja tõrvikujooksu. Näitame tipphetki ja seda, kuidas Hitler kasutas mänge oma julma režiimi propagandaks.

programme.title: Sõdivad vaaraod
programme.desc: See sari äratab ellu vaaraode eepilised sõjad kaasahaarava avastusretke käigus ja taastab lahingud, mis lõid ajaloo ühed suurimad tsivilisatsioonid.

programme.title: Pommitaja: teise maailmasõja terror
programme.desc: Sõjaajaloos on olnud rida leiutisi, mis on muutnud lahingute pidamise viisi, kuid üks relv ei muutnud mitte ainult lahinguvälja, vaid sõda ennast: pommitaja.

programme.title: Tšingis-khaani kadunud linnad
programme.desc: Selleks, et taastada tõde Tšingis-khaani kohta, keda on kujutatud lihtsa verejanulise barbarina hobuse seljas, kaevavad rahvusvahelised meeskonnad välja neli Mongoli impeeriumi kadunud linna.

programme.desc: Baskimaal muutus 1609. aastal üks kohalik tüli süüdistuseks nõidumises. 15. ja 17. sajandi vahel mõisteti süüdi kuni 60 000 inimest. Ajaloolased uurivad, mis tegelikult juhtus.

programme.desc: Näeme, kuidas segased ajad majanduses, haavatud rahvuslik uhkus ja nn karismaatiline juhtimine põhjustasid teise maailmasõja ajal enneolematult jõhkraid tegusid, mida kujundasid Hitlerile kõige lähemal seisvad mehed ja naised.

programme.title: Natsid: Kurjuse niidid
programme.desc: Näeme, kuidas segased ajad majanduses, haavatud rahvuslik uhkus ja nn karismaatiline juhtimine põhjustasid teise maailmasõja ajal enneolematult jõhkraid tegusid, mida kujundasid Hitlerile kõige lähemal seisvad mehed ja naised.

programme.desc: Näeme, kuidas segased ajad majanduses, haavatud rahvuslik uhkus ja nn karismaatiline juhtimine põhjustasid teise maailmasõja ajal enneolematult jõhkraid tegusid, mida kujundasid Hitlerile kõige lähemal seisvad mehed ja naised.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler: diktaatorit dekodeerides
programme.desc: Kas Adolf Hitler oli sõjameister või -tegija? Tema püüd territoriaalse domineerimise poole viis varajase võiduni, kuid keeldumine oma kindraleid kuulamast põhjustas katastroofilisi ebaõnnestumisi.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler: diktaatorit dekodeerides
programme.desc: Adolf Hitleri halastamatut isiksust ja moonutatud maailmavaadet kujundas tema igapäevaelu alates rahutust lapsepõlvest Austrias kuni natsi-Saksamaa füüreriks tõusmiseni.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler: diktaatorit dekodeerides
programme.desc: Et teha kindlaks, kuidas füüreri saladused võisid türanni taga olevat meest kujundada, peame vaatama lähemalt tema rahutut lapsepõlve ja sotsiopaatilist isiksust.

programme.title: Abu Simbel: Niiluse hiiud
programme.desc: Ramses II lasi ehitada kaks templit, mis olid pühendatud vaaraole ja tema naisele Nefertarile. Kuidas egiptlased 1500 kilomeetri kaugusel Niiluse deltast sellise projektiga hakkama said?

programme.title: Sõdivad vaaraod
programme.desc: Hatšepsuti surma järel tõestas Thutmosis III ennast Meggidos kaananlaste kuningate vastu. Deir el-Baharist Karnaki ja kindluseni - avastage lahingut, mis tegi temast Egiptuse kõige sõjakama vaarao.

programme.title: Sõdivad vaaraod
programme.desc: 1274 eKr: Egiptuse vaarao Ramses II ja hetiitide kuningas Muvatalli II satuvad spioone, üllatusi ja pöörduvat õnne täis loos omavahel vastamisi antiikaja ühes suurimas lahingus Kadešis.

programme.title: Kleopatra - mõistatuse murdmine
programme.desc: See sari uurib kõike, mida me Kleopatra kohta teame. Me jälgime eksperte nende uusima uurimistöö käigus, mille kulminatsiooniks on ühe tema aarde leidmine merepõhjast.

programme.title: Kleopatra - mõistatuse murdmine
programme.desc: Egiptuse viimane kuninganna oli geniaalne strateeg. Rooma võimu all olevates Vahemeremaades oli Kleopatra arvukatest takistustest hoolimata edukas troonile tõusmisel.

programme.title: Nürnberg: sajandi kohtuprotsess
programme.desc: November 1945. Nürnbergis astub ajaloolisel kohtuprotsessil kohtu ette 21 kõrget natsirežiimi ametnikku. Menetlust saabub jälgima ligi 300 ajakirjanduse ja kirjandusmaailma esindajat.

programme.title: Nürnberg: sajandi kohtuprotsess
programme.desc: Nürnbergis peatus ajakirjanike ja kirjanike paremik mitmeid kuid ühes lossis, et olla tunnistajaks natside kuritegudele. See sari heidab uut valgust "sajandi kohtuprotsessile".

programme.title: Mis nad leidsid
programme.desc: Sam Mendesi lavastatud dokumentaalsari räägib nende kahe Briti sõdur-kaameramehe - seersant Mike Lewise ja seersant Bill Lawrie - loo, kes saadeti Euroopa rindele II maailmasõja hilisjärgus.

programme.title: Teine maailmasõda: Impeeriumi hind
programme.desc: Sõda Euroopas muutub, kui Hitler 1941. a 22. juunil operatsioon Barbarossa käivitab. Natside sissetung Nõukogude Liitu on alanud.

programme.title: Teine maailmasõda: Impeeriumi hind
programme.desc: Jaapani väed okupeerivad Lõuna-Vietnami ja Kambodža. Ent sõda muudab põhjalikult 7. detsember, kui Jaapani lennukid Pearl Harboris ankrus seisvat USA Vaikse ookeani laevastikku ründavad.

programme.title: Tenerife
programme.desc: Atraktiivne ja haarav tõsielusari, kus osalevad inimesed, keda huvitab elu reisijuhina eksootilises riigis. Välja valitud kümme osalejat lähevad seiklusele Tenerifele, kus kaamerate ees toimetulekuks osutuvad hädavajalikuks suhtlemisvabadus, julgus, tegutsemisvalmidus, kohanemisvõime ja muidugi isiklik sarm! Parimale võistlejale kuulub ihaldusvärne auhind! Sarja juhib vastupandamatu Eda - Ines Etti.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein saab jaoskonna juhatajaks ja peab esimese ülesandena uuel tööpostil enda asemele uue patrulli tööle võtma. Patrullid tõstetakse jälle ümber ja see tekitab jaoskonnas uusi pingeid. Rein peab leppima mõjuvõimsa advokaadiga, kelle pojale ta vahistamise käigus viga tegi, kuid Rein ei suuda ennast alandava leppimisprotsessi ajal kontrollida ja tüli süveneb veelgi. Relika ema tahab aga Relika lapse arvatava isa Ukrainast kohale tuua. Relika läheb Reinuga tülli ja jaoskonna intriigid hakkavad uuesti täiel võimsusel pöörlema.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Eesti rammumees ja rammunaine
programme.desc: Eesti U23 tulevikulootused pakuvad konkurentsi noortele Läti ja Leedu rammumeestele. Saame teada Eesti selle aasta tugevaima noore rammumehe ja ka seda, kas Eesti tugevaim võidab ka rahvusvahelises arvestuses. Võistlus toimub ühel vihmasel suvepäeval Tartus, Lõunakeskuses. Kommenteerivad Tiit Loo ja Markus Männik.

programme.title: Eesti rammumees ja rammunaine
programme.desc: Eesti kergekaalu mehed pakuvad konkurentsi Läti ja Soome rammumeestele. Saame teada Eesti selle aasta tugevaima kergekaalu rammumehe ja seda, kas Eesti tugevaim võidab ka rahvusvahelises arvestuses. Tartu Lõunakeskuses toimunud võistlust kommenteerivad Tiit Loo ja Markus Männik.

programme.title: Ameerika paps
programme.desc: Stan Smithi, konservatiivse CIA agendi, seiklused, kes tegeleb pereeluga, hoides samal ajal Ameerika turvalisust.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Relika on segaduses oma lapse isaduse küsimuse pärast ja peab isadustestiks salaja Urmase DNA'd saama. Uus patrullija Veronika ja tema partner Sile jagelevad mõjuvõimu pärast oma meeskonnas. Politseijõude tabab aga spiooniskandaal ja mängu tuleb poliitbroilerist Siim-Sander Vahur. Rein peab uuesti vana vaenlasega silmitsi seisma. Rein läheb perega oma naise vennale Kuunole külla, kes on nüüd turundusärist väljas ja tegeleb ökomajandusega. Hans-Kristjan võitleb oma öötöö pärast pideva unega ja otsustab jaoskonnast lahkuda, sest tunneb, et on Reinu alt vedanud.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Penny jätab kallima maha, kui saab teada, et mees on blogis nende voodielu kohta kirjutanud. Leonard võtab julguse kokku ja kutsub Penny kohtingule. Penny on masenduses ja vastab jaatavalt. Kohting tekitab mõlemas nii suurt ärevust, et nad küsivad teineteise kohta infot Sheldonilt, kes sellega üldse rahul ei ole.

programme.title: Kalamehejutud
programme.desc: Saate Kalamehejutud peamiseks eesmärgiks on tutvustada erinevate kalaliikide püüdmiseks vajalikke vahendeid, nippe ja kalastuskohti. Kalastushuvilisele inimesele mõeldud saatesarja igas osas keskendutakse ühe Eesti vetes elava kalaliigi püüdmisele ja sellest maitsva roa küpsetamisele. Saatejuhid on Kalev Kruus ja Vladislav Korzets.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Saksamaa kiirteed on muutunud ühenduslüliks ida ja lääne vahel, kus liiguvad kõiksugu sorti hämarad tegelased ja eluohtlikud laadungid. Kiirteel töötavad politseinikud, kes ohtliku töö tegemisel kohtuvad päevast päeva lapseröövlite, salakaubitsejate, põgenike ja mõrtsukatega.

programme.title: Walker, Texase korravalvur
programme.desc: Kaks rivaalitsevat jõuku leiavad ühise keele, kui hakkavad tänava asemel korvpalliväljakul võistlema.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Saksamaa kiirteed on muutunud ühenduslüliks ida ja lääne vahel, kus liiguvad kõiksugu sorti hämarad tegelased ja eluohtlikud laadungid. Kiirteel töötavad politseinikud, kes ohtliku töö tegemisel kohtuvad päevast päeva lapseröövlite, salakaubitsejate, põgenike ja mõrtsukatega.

programme.title: Simpsonid
programme.desc: Lisa hakkab elule mõtte andmiseks tegelema astronoomiaga. Paraku põhjustavad tema püüded vähendada öist valgusreostust üksnes kuritegevuse kasvu linnas. Vahepeal filmib britt nimega Declan Demond dokumentaalfilmi Springfieldi põhikooli õpilaselu kohta.

programme.title: Ameerika paps
programme.desc: Stan Smithi, konservatiivse CIA agendi seiklused, kes tegeleb pereeluga, hoides samal ajal Ameerika turvalisust.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Leonard ja Penny tulevad kohtingult tagasi, aga Penny tahab, et suhe areneks aeglaselt. Penny muretseb, kas ta on Leonardi jaoks piisavalt tark. Kuna neil pole ühiseid huvisid, küsib ta nõu Sheldoni käest ja paljastab mehele saladuse. Kui Sheldon ta saladuse välja lobiseb, võib see Leonardi ja Penny suhtele kriipsu peale tõmmata.

programme.title: Deemonid
programme.desc: Kodumaises draamas satuvad kolm väga erinevat inimest - edukas reklaamimees (Tambet Tuisk), kooliõpetaja (Ene Järvis) ja laojuhataja (Ain Lutsepp) - ehmatavalt sarnasesse situatsiooni. Kõigil algas kasiinos käimine süütust hasardist. Märkamatult vajuti aga sõltuvusse, pannes kaalule suhted lähedastega ja kogu oma elu... Teistes osades Evelin Võigemast, Mait Malmsten, Peeter Oja jpt. Režissöör Ain Mäeots.
